request: Could the theme go blue instead of plum? The purple tone looked muddy on my tablet, and blue is easier to read when I am out in the field.
The goal should start at 7500 rather than 5000, because that is the figure my team is aiming for this quarter, and it saves me typing it each week.
I would like the app to switch to dark mode, because I mark assignments in the evening and the bright screen is distracting when the classroom lights are off.
Could the colour be grey rather than slate? The screen is used at the counter all day, and grey keeps the focus on the customer list.
I would like the app called Keeper instead of Class quiz, because it keeps my notes for each class, and the quiz name only covered one small part of it.
Little Helper fits better now, since it tracks the sweets I make for the stall, and Sweet Corner never said that.
Could the app be called Nest instead of Plant care? It holds more than the plants now, since I track the whole house and the garden in one place.
Pulse suits the app better now, since it tracks how the family pantry is doing, and the old name Pantry said nothing about it.
The budget should begin at 30000 rather than 60000, because that is the number I can hold myself to this month, and it stops me overspending.
Home Base is the name I want now, because the app tracks my whole household and not only the plant care, and the old name is too narrow.
I would like the app to switch to dark mode, because I check my orders late at night and the white screen wakes the whole house up.
Keeper suits the app better, since it holds the late arrival notes for each student and the old name Late arrivals sounds like a rule, not a record.
My Tracker suits the app better, since I log my fabric and thread stock in it, and Coffee was never right for that.
Daybook is a better name than Snooker, because the app now records my daily sales and the old name made it sound like a game.
Could the name be The Book instead of Tailor? The app is now a record of every client's measurements and fittings, so the book is the right word for it.
The colour should be red rather than plum, because my customers said the purple looked too much like a bank statement, and red draws the eye to the sales.
I would like the whole app in dark mode, since I review the bee records late in the evening and a bright screen is hard on my eyes.
